name: WildToolBench
intro: WildToolBench（也称为WildBench）是一个用于评估大型语言模型在真实世界场景中工具使用能力的基准测试。该基准由艾伦人工智能研究所开发，包含多样化的工具使用任务。
intro_en: WildToolBench (also known as WildBench) is a benchmark developed by the Allen Institute for AI to evaluate large language models' tool usage capabilities in real-world scenarios. It includes a diverse set of tool usage tasks.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with WildToolBench, Benchmarking LLM Tool-Use in the Wild, arXiv:2604.06185v1 (2026-02-13; ICLR 2026), Sections 3.1-3.6, Sections 4.1-4.2, the dependency-DAG algorithm appendix, and Appendix C; official repository https://github.com/yupeijei1997/WildToolBench. Hard identity guard: WildToolBench is not WildBench arXiv:2406.04770 and is unrelated to https://github.com/allenai/WildBench. Count units must remain explicit: 256 scenarios/sessions x 4 linked tasks = 1,024 tasks; the four tasks are not independent rows. API counts are reported as 1,600+ collected public APIs, approximately 1,600 APIs retained across 400 tool lists. The human dependency DAG is annotated only after trajectory correction, and the 62% -> 78% -> 86% -> 94% -> 100% sequence is a QC progression, not a model score.. WildToolBench analyzes large-scale real-user tool-use logs to derive scenarios and three challenges: compositional tool orchestration, hidden-intention inference through dialogue, and adaptive policy switching under instruction transitions. Raw logs are not released; uniformly sampled examples guide a controlled User Agent that varies syntax, style, background, length, and difficulty. The benchmark collects 1,600+ public APIs into 400 cleaned tool lists with broad parameter-type coverage and five-expert repair. Each of 256 sessions contains four linked tasks: one of four first-task types followed by three dependency-bearing tasks based on partial omission, coreference, or long-range context. Assistant trajectories undergo automatic error checks, five-expert correction, then human DAG annotation. Nine experts work for one month; repeated 20% reviews and four QC iterations resolve conflicts, rewrite overly organized dialogue, enrich intent switches, and fix calls until sampled error is zero and conflicts are resolved. The final 1,024 tasks cover 8 major and 24 subcategories, averaging 5.27 turns per session and 1.92 tool-call steps. Evaluation reports Task Accuracy, all-four Session Accuracy, Optimal Path Rate, and Accomplishment Progress Rate.

flowchart LR real_logs["大规模真实工具使用日志
收集真实用户与智能体交互的历史脱敏日志
真实反映人类在日常调用工具时的自然语言行为模式"] derive_challenges["场景抽象与三大核心挑战确立

覆盖从基础简单参数到深层嵌套 JSON 对象的全谱系"] tool_qc_gate["工具组合与接口规范质检门禁

完善歧义参数说明并补充必要的调用前置条件"] clean_tools["专家清洗后的标准工具名录
400 套经过严格工程加固的标准化工具集合
为多智能体仿真推演提供坚固可信的接口底座"] scenario_seed["256 个精选业务场景种子
构建具有高度代表性的多轮业务场景设计蓝图
全面覆盖个人生活助理与企业专业运维研发赛道"] controlled_user["受控用户智能体动态仿真
丰富语言句法、表达风格、背景信息、叙述长度与难度
高保真模拟不同性格与表达习惯的真实用户"] first_task_pool["首任务多类型题库
涵盖单工具直调、多步组合调用、无工具闲聊与需澄清
确立长程会话的首轮交互基调与多样化开局"] candidate_pool["后续 3 项关联任务库
引入关键信息省略、代词指代消歧与跨多轮长程依赖
深度考验模型在连续交互中的上下文追踪与记忆力"] expert_select["专家精选与协同打磨
资深评测专家逐组筛选并润色四步会话链条
确保四项任务之间的过渡自然且逻辑因果严密"] four_task_session["256 组完整会话（每组 4 个连续任务）
封存精心编排的高保真多轮评测会话全集
包含 1,024 道前后紧密嵌套的序列化子任务"] assistant_trajectory["执行候选轨迹与自动化筛查
驱动模型推演并自动扫描执行中的异常表现
实时捕获幻觉调用、参数类型失配与多余无效调用"] trajectory_issue["工具调用异常研判门禁
判断推演轨迹是否存在不可执行调用或逻辑短路
标记规划不当、参数拼写错误与死循环"] expert_trajectory_fix["5 位专家人工修正规划与参数
专家团队亲自上手重写错误工具调用与入参
确保沉淀的标准轨迹代表最优且严密的标准解法"] human_dag["人工标注工具调用依赖 DAG
资深专家人工标注调用之间的严格因果依赖 DAG
形式化界定可并行异步调用的接口与严格前置依赖"] random_review["每轮随机抽检 20% 交叉复核
每轮次抽取五分之一的数据由独立小组背对背核查
保证各标注组间质量基线的一致性与高标准"] qc_gate["零缺陷与零冲突质检门禁
强制要求抽检样本错误率为零且所有分歧裁决完毕
见证合格率从 62% 递进至 78%、86%、94% 最终达 100%"] resolve_rewrite["仲裁分歧、重构对话与丰富切换
轮换复审专家组合、重写过于死板机械的句式
精雕细琢各种微妙的意图突变与反转场景"] final_benchmark["WildToolBench 1,024 题正式基准发布
256 会话 × 4 级联任务 = 1,024 个标准用例
涵盖 8 大类与 24 子类，平均每会话 5.27 轮交互"] runtime_session["原生 Function-Call 会话执行推演
受测模型在原生函数调用模式下通跑全会话
接收动态环境回显并自主推进多轮任务处理"] align_gold["预测调用与黄金 DAG 对齐匹配
将智能体实际生成的工具调用序列映射至黄金 DAG
智能包容无依赖并行工具调用的次序差异"] metric_family["评价指标族分流路由器
解耦绝对任务/会话正确率与调用路径优化度核算
分别挂载对应的数学计算与统计逻辑"] exact_scoring["任务与会话级严格准确率 (Accuracy)
按单步核算 Task Accuracy；连续 4 题全对才计入 Session Accuracy
真实体现长程连续交互的无差错稳定性"] dag_dfs["DFS 拓扑路径枚举与顺序增量匹配
通过深度优先搜索穷举 DAG 所有合法串并行执行拓扑
按智能体实际执行顺序展开增量式的步进比对"] opr["最优路径率 (OPR) 与达成进度率 (APR)
OPR 评估是否采用最小深度最优解；APR 统计达成节点比例
全面刻画智能体调用的规划智慧与执行效率"] metric_report["WildToolBench 综合评测总报
输出任务与会话级准确率、OPR 最优路径率与 APR 进度雷达
交付全面诊断野外真实工具使用能力的权威大报"] real_logs --> derive_challenges derive_challenges --> challenge_pool real_logs -. 仅均匀抽样 .-> fewshot_examples tool_lists --> tool_qc_gate tool_qc_gate -->|是| clean_tools tool_qc_gate -. 否 .-> expert_tool_fix expert_tool_fix -.-> tool_qc_gate challenge_pool --> scenario_seed fewshot_examples -.-> scenario_seed clean_tools -.-> scenario_seed scenario_seed --> controlled_user controlled_user --> first_task_pool first_task_pool --> candidate_pool candidate_pool --> expert_select expert_select --> four_task_session four_task_session --> assistant_trajectory assistant_trajectory --> trajectory_issue trajectory_issue -. 是 .-> expert_trajectory_fix trajectory_issue -->|否| human_dag expert_trajectory_fix -.-> assistant_trajectory human_dag --> random_review random_review --> qc_gate qc_gate -->|是| final_benchmark qc_gate -. 否 .-> resolve_rewrite resolve_rewrite -.-> random_review final_benchmark --> runtime_session runtime_session --> align_gold align_gold --> metric_family metric_family -->|精确成功| exact_scoring metric_family -->|编排诊断| dag_dfs dag_dfs --> opr exact_scoring --> metric_report opr --> metric_report
